Loss Functions Module¶

lossfx wraps PyTorch’s loss functions, optimisers, and learning-rate schedulers into a single C++ class, and provides weight-initialisation utilities for torch::nn::Sequential networks. It is used internally by model_template and exposed to Python via OptimizerConfig in AnalysisG.core.lossfx.

Class: lossfx¶

Header: <templates/lossfx.h>

Inheritance: tools, notification

Supported Loss Functions¶

The following PyTorch loss functions are selectable by name (case-insensitive):
